run_questionnaire_simulation: run a QuestionnaireSimulation with a config, language model, and embedder to execute questionnaire-based agent simulations
add_game_master_to_simulation: add a game master entity to the simulation using an instance config with GAME_MASTER or INITIALIZER role
add_entity_to_simulation: add an entity to the simulation using an instance config with ENTITY role and optional pre-loaded memory state
save_simulation_checkpoint: save the current state of all entities and game masters to a JSON checkpoint file at a given step
load_simulation_from_checkpoint: load entity and game master states from a checkpoint dictionary to restore or update the simulation
